_about: General terms used on many pages. Owner: supervisor. Other writers: reuse these ids; do not redefine them. Each batch adds its own terms in src/glossary/<batch>.json.

afd.short: Attention-FFN Disaggregation. The attention part and the feed-forward (FFN/MoE) part of a model run in separate server processes and exchange hidden states.

plugin.short: The vLLM external plugin that adds AFD. vLLM loads it; it changes no vLLM source file.

attention-role.short: The side that runs attention and sends hidden states to the FFN side. The default role of a process.
attention-role.long: The role is set in AFDConfig.role; the default is "attention" ({{cite afd_plugin/config.py:56}}).

ffn-role.short: The side that runs the feed-forward and MoE experts. It receives hidden states, computes, and sends the result back.

attention-server.short: The vllm serve process that plays the attention role. It owns the API server, the scheduler and the KV cache.

ffn-server.short: The vllm serve process that plays the FFN role. It has no API server, no scheduler and no KV cache; a connector loop drives it.

connector.short: The object that moves hidden states between the attention role and the FFN role. Each connector picks one transport.

control-plane.short: The path that carries DP metadata (per-stage token counts) from the attention side to the FFN side. It is optional.
control-plane.long: The control plane is an AFDControlPlane ({{cite afd_plugin/connectors/base.py:258}}); a connector exposes it as control_plane, or sets it to None.

data-plane.short: The path that carries the hidden-state tensors between the two roles. It is the connector's send and receive calls.

dbo.short: Dual-batch overlap. The step is split into two microbatches so compute and communication overlap. AFD uses exactly two.

ubatch.short: A microbatch: one of the two token groups that DBO runs at the same time. On the wire its index is the stage.

stage.short: The DBO ubatch index of one transfer on the wire. A connector sends one transfer per layer and stage.
stage.long: The transfer metadata carries stage_idx next to layer_idx ({{cite afd_plugin/connectors/metadata.py:188-190}}).

xayf.short: A topology name: x attention ranks and y FFN ranks, for example 2A2F. Use it only in topology names, not in prose.

entry-point.short: A Python packaging hook. vLLM reads the vllm.general_plugins entry points and calls each one at start-up.

general-plugin.short: A vLLM plugin in the vllm.general_plugins group. vLLM loads it with load_general_plugins in several processes.

register-afd.short: The plugin entry function. It applies the compat patches and registers the routing strategy, the DBO op and the model wrappers.
register-afd.long: Defined in the package init ({{cite afd_plugin/__init__.py:142}}); it guards against a second run.

additional-config.short: A vLLM config field. The plugin reads its "afd" key for the role, the connector, the topology sizes and the host/port.

afd-config.short: The plugin's own configuration object. It holds the role, the connector name, the topology sizes and the rendezvous host/port.

worker-cls.short: The vLLM parallel-config field that names the worker class. The plugin rewrites it, but only when it is "auto".

enginecore.short: The vLLM v1 engine core process. On the FFN role it returns early after the executor is built: no scheduler, no loop.

model-runner-v2.short: The vLLM v1 model runner, version 2. Both roles need VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1. AFD adds a seam over it.

model-wrapper.short: An AFD<arch> model class that makes a model role-aware. On the attention side the FFN stage becomes a remote proxy.

remote-ffn-proxy.short: A parameter-free module on the attention side. It replaces the FFN stage of a decoder layer and uses the connector instead.

role-rank.short: The rank of a process inside its own role group. It comes from the DP, PCP and TP placement.

p2p-subgroup.short: In the GPU P2P connector, one FFN rank plus the attention ranks mapped to it. The FFN rank is subgroup rank 0.

full-decode-only.short: The only CUDA graph mode that AFD supports on GPU. Graphs capture decode steps only; other batches run eager.
full-decode-only.long: The GPU set of supported modes has this one member ({{cite afd_plugin/v1/worker/cuda_graph.py:20-21}}). The NPU runner accepts FULL and FULL_DECODE_ONLY ({{cite afd_plugin/validation.py:235-238}}).

custom-op.short: A function registered as torch.ops.vllm.* so torch.compile and CUDA graphs can trace it. The P2P sends and receives are custom ops.

patch.short: A compat module that replaces a vLLM function at load time. The plugin applies a small set of patches.

pynccl.short: vLLM's thin NCCL wrapper, PyNcclCommunicator. The GPU P2P connector uses it to send and receive tensors.
pynccl.long: The class is defined in vLLM ({{cite vllm:vllm/distributed/device_communicators/pynccl.py:91}}).

cam.short: The Ascend NPU communication operators used by the NPU connectors. One connector is synchronous, the other asynchronous.

compute-gate-on-attention.short: An AFD config flag. When true, the attention side computes the MoE gate and sends the router logits to the FFN side.
compute-gate-on-attention.long: The flag defaults to false ({{cite afd_plugin/config.py:66}}).

commit.short: One saved version of a git repository. A 40-character id names it. This site explains one pinned commit of each repository.

citation.short: A link to a file and line in the code. Every claim about the code on this site has one.
